description: Standalone command-line tool for Octarine workspaces: search, edit and organize local Markdown notes from the shell, or serve them to AI agents over MCP
notes: Use 'scoop update octarine-cli' to update; do not run 'octarine update', which replaces the binary outside Scoop's control.
For AI agents, run 'octarine agent-guide' to print the usage guide, or 'octarine mcp' to serve the CLI as MCP tools over stdio.
PowerShell tab completion: add 'octarine completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression' to your profile.
